mcabp.config.rendering_enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When disabled, no villager breasts will be rendered.
mcabp.config.physics_enabled.tooltip: When disabled, breasts stop bouncing but still render normally.
mcabp.config.bounce_multiplier.tooltip: Higher values make impacts and jumps cause more movement. Walking sway is not affected.
mcabp.config.floppy_multiplier.tooltip: Higher values make the wobble last longer after an impact; lower values settle quickly.
mcabp.config.dual_physics.tooltip: Each side wobbles on its own for a more natural look. When off, both sides move in perfect sync.
mcabp.config.show_in_armor.tooltip: When on, breasts stay visible even under chest armor that covers them. When off, the armor hides them.
mcabp.config.armor_physics_override.tool: When on, chest armor no longer dampens the wobble. When off, tighter armor means less movement.
